courseDescription: This postgraduate programme is designed to help you develop the skills and knowledge required to manage engineering projects effectively.
tuitionFeeNote: Fees are set in advance of each calendar year and will be updated on this website.

minimumProgrammeRequirements.qualification: Four-year bachelors degree in engineering at a recognised university (or similar institution)
requirements: Broad coverage in your first year of the foundational science topics that underpin engineering disciplines: mathematical modelling, chemical and materials science, electrical engineering theory, mechanics, programming, and engineering design.
A research project or dissertation comprising at least one-quarter of the final year.
